g.title: B2
g.text: B2 Power distribution (SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 Rev B; EPS board SQSO-EPS-BRD-001 Version B)
limits nominal, from SQSO-EPS-BRD-001 §8.3 · OBC enable pins from SQSO-ICX-001 §3.1 · all enables low at OBC reset (100 kΩ pull-downs)

g.title: cluster_inh
g.text: Inhibits (CDS 2.3.7/2.3.8: three physical, each switch on its own rail and harness; RBF does not count)

g.title: cluster_reg
g.text: Converters (LMR43620-Q1, 42 V input, synchronised to 1.000 MHz)

g.title: cluster_sw
g.text: Load switches (OBC enable lines; outputs low at reset)

g.title: PASS
g.text: fired only by EOL_ARM PF4 AND EOL_FIRE PG1

g.title: BMS
g.text: COV 4.25 V · CUV 2.80 V · OCD 4 A · SCD 10 A

g.title: DS2
g.text: Q6 + Q7 back to back in the pack return

g.title: DS3
g.text: NO contact holds the trackers' TRK_EN low

g.title: VBAT
g.text: hardware load shed < 13.6 V for 5 s

g.title: RBF
g.text: in series with DS2's drive; clamps TRK_EN

g.title: ADC
g.text: VBATT PC2 (pack / 6) · IBATT PC3 · VSOLAR PC4
ISOLAR PC5 · VBUS PB0 · VJET_RB PA7 · VSW1_RB PA1

g.title: INA
g.text: INA228 on I2C2: pack gauge 0x44, array 0x40
INA3221 × 4, ADS7138, AFE on the controller's bus

g.title: BURN
g.text: 4 burn drivers, 0.8 A each, 12 s one-shot
one resistor at a time: 0.67 A at the pack

g.title: OBC
g.text: 25-40 mA (3V3_RTC to the RV-3028 always on)

g.title: RXT
g.text: RF board: UHF RX, KISS TNC, exciter
